CHAPTER.VERS: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, and, ?”
They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ? We don’t know what he is saying.”
Therefore Yeshua perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them,
His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you speak plainly, and speak no figures of speech.
Now we know that you know all things, and don’t need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came from God.”
